messages:
Maria: Quick note  Rowan's birthday is Thurs. Thinking of a tiny desk surprise: one helium balloon + a succulent plant + a handwritten card. Opinions? :seedling: :balloon:
people-ops-bot: FYI budget tag `POPS-58`. React with :balloon: for balloon+plant, :gift: for gift card only. Poll open until Wed 4pm.
Josh: Love the succulent idea (low maintenance). I can pick it up Wed afternoon.
Keiko: I'll write a card and bring colored pens. Also Rowan prefers no latex due to mild allergy (PVC/foil balloons only pls).
Sam: I'll grab a foil balloon and a small foil-wrapped chocolate (GF). If anyone objects to chocolate, say so.
Lili: Remote  I'll record a 15s silly birthday message and send $10 for the gift card.
Maria: Thanks! Noted on PVC/foil balloons only. People-ops-bot: poll currently :balloon: x3.
Josh: I'll tuck the plant at Rowan's desk at 9:15am and set the balloon weight so it doesn't float away.
Keiko: I'll leave the card on top of the monitor and snap a pic after the surprise.
Sam: Sent $10 for the candy/gift card fund.
people-ops-bot: Reminder scheduled Thu 9:00am "Place Rowan's desk surprise".
Maria: Perfect. Remote folks we'll DM the e-gift and post the pic in #memes. Thanks team! :tada:
